title: Base guarded trader (OpenAI Agents SDK)
summary: Reads Base market data (block, gas, Chainlink ETH/USD) and hands the Sato Kit's tools to an OpenAI Agents SDK agent as function tools; the runner stops for a person's approval before any prepare that would sign and before execute. Every intent is quoted, prepared, simulated and checked by a policy pre-flight that names the rule, limit and observed value of every refusal. Fixture mode runs the SDK's runner with a scripted model: no model API, no key, no network. It signs only on a local fork with a throwaway key or on Base Sepolia with a managed wallet, and never on mainnet.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command over the shipped recordings (no network, no key, no model API) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json: exit 0, the over-cap intent refused with its rule, limit and observed value, and the execute call stopped at the runner's approval interruption.
The template's own tests. Recorded, never the verdict.
Nightly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: an anvil fork of Base at block 51800000 with recorded quotes; exact reads, an approve simulation and pre-flight outcomes. Never broadcasts.

Weekly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: against the public Base Sepolia RPC with no key, chain reads through the kit checked on contract constants and answer shapes (never on moving balances), plus this template's testnet answers. Never signs, never broadcasts.

provenance.notes: Same goal as base-guarded-trader/plain-ts, hosted by the OpenAI Agents SDK through @satohub/kit/openai-agents. Deterministic over fixtures with a scripted model inside the SDK's runner. Live model, fork and testnet modes are opt-in and never run in the platform's offline test phase.
